reason: Hypothesis A proposes a physically sound mechanism (nanoscale Hf-rich precipitates enhancing work hardening) that directly addresses the limitation of poor strain hardening in the specified HfZrTiTa0.53 alloy, with a clear, testable experiment and no reliance on potentially inapplicable evidence from a different alloy system. Hypothesis B cites evidence from a eutectic Al0.7CoCrFeNi alloy with a different microstructure and composition, making its L12 precipitation mechanism less grounded for this material, and it includes an unjustified precise strength improvement value.
